readme: entries = rows from a published list that places the body in Nyamira (as printed). mentions = named bodies in county documents; not registers; basis says how firm each is. nameMatchesNoLocation = PBORA register rows whose NAME contains a Nyamira place word; the register has no location, so these are NOT confirmed to be in Nyamira. Nothing has been cleaned beyond whitespace.

registers.title: List of Licensed and Authorised Sacco Societies in Kenya for the Financial Year Ending 31st December 2026
registers.date: PDF created 2 Feb 2026; posted on sasra.go.ke 13 Mar 2026
registers.coverage: Schedule I: 176 deposit-taking SACCOs licensed for 2026; Schedule II: 176 non-withdrawable-deposit-taking SACCOs authorised; Schedule III: 5 restricted licences; Schedule IV: 1 revoked. Only SASRA-regulated SACCOs; the many small SACCOs supervised by the Commissioner for Co-operative Development are not in it.
registers.nyamiraEntries: 0 rows with county printed as Nyamira. 1 row whose address is in Nyamira (Vision Point Sacco, Nyansiongo/Borabu) but whose county column is printed "Kisii".
registers.usable: Yes, as an official list of regulated SACCOs; county column cannot be trusted for Nyamira (see Vision Point).

registers.title: List of Licensed and Authorised Sacco Societies in Kenya for the Financial Year Ending 31st December 2025
registers.nyamiraEntries: Same as 2026: Vision Point Sacco (row 167) with county printed "Kisii"; no other Nyamira address.

registers.title: List of PBOs (web page)
registers.publisher: Public Benefit Organizations Regulatory Authority (PBORA), formerly NGOs Co-ordination Board
registers.date: live page, retrieved 2026-10-29; no as-of date printed
registers.nyamiraEntries: Cannot be determined: the list has no location, county or area-of-operation field. 10 names contain a Nyamira place word (see nameMatchesNoLocation); several are clearly elsewhere (e.g. Nyamirambo, South Mugirango).
registers.usable: No, not as a Nyamira directory (no location). Useful only to confirm that a named organisation is registered and to get its reference number.

registers.title: Annual PBO Sector Report 2024/2025
registers.nyamiraEntries: Counts only: Table 3 "The Distribution of PBOs Across Counties" (newly registered PBOs by intended county of operation): Nyamira 22 (p.18, PDF p.32; table starts p.17). Table 4 "Project Implementation per County": Nyamira 212 (p.18, PDF p.32; column header printed "No. of PBOs" but text calls these projects).
registers.usable: For two county-level counts only; no names.

registers.title: Annual NGO Sector Report 2022/2023
registers.nyamiraEntries: Counts only: Table 3.3 "County of operations for newly registered NGOs": Nyamira 16 (p.26). Table 3.4 "Project Implementation per County": Nyamira 251 projects (p.27). NGOs can operate in several counties.

registers.title: Our Factories: Nyamira County
registers.nyamiraEntries: 6 tea factories listed under Nyamira County.
registers.usable: Yes for tea factories, but these are factory companies managed by KTDA, not co-operative societies or community groups; KTDA is a private company, not a regulator.

registers.title: Nyamira County Integrated Development Plan 2018-2022, s.1.22 Community Organizations/Non-State Actors and Table 16
registers.nyamiraEntries: Names 4 non-state actors (narrative, p.43-44, PDF p.61-62). Co-operatives: text says "The total number of registered cooperatives is 104 of which 74 are active with a total membership of 225,000 of whom 168,000 are active (75%)"; Table 16 (p.44, PDF p.62; source line "Cooperative annual report Nyamira County") gives Manga 7, Masaba North 22, Nyamira South 39, Nyamira North 16, Borabu 22, Total 106 (text 104 vs table 106: conflict in the source).
registers.usable: Counts and a few names; old (2018).

registers.title: Nyamira CIDP 2023-2027
registers.nyamiraEntries: List of tables names "Table 33: Distribution of Cooperative Societies within the Sub-Counties" but the table is not in the body (broken cross-reference). Review of the previous plan (p.31, PDF p.46) says the sector formed "8 new co-operative societies while reviving 5". No register of names.

registers.title: Nyamira County Statistical Abstract 2015
registers.publisher: KNBS (copy hosted by Council of Governors Maarifa)
registers.nyamiraEntries: Counts only. Table 8.1 Co-operatives by type, status, membership and turnover 2013-2014 (p.12, PDF p.28; source: county trade department), e.g. 2014 provisional: Dairy 12 (7 active), Coffee 10 (10), Rural Saccos 15 (10), Urban Sacco 31 (23), Livestock 17 (12), Multipurpose 9 (5). Table 17.1 Registered women groups and 17.2 registered youth groups (p.42, PDF p.58): the rows are hard to interpret ("Registered Women Groups 188/365" and "No. of Groups (SHG's) 418/435"; footnote says women-group data is for Borabu sub-county only).
registers.usable: Old and internally unclear; not a directory. No later Nyamira edition found on knbs.or.ke (tested 2018-2023 file names: 404).

registers.title: County ADPs 2024/25 and 2025/26; Fourth Quarter Budget Implementation Report FY2025/26
registers.nyamiraEntries: Scattered mentions of named groups and co-operatives (see mentions). ADP ward tables are proposals from public participation, not records of funding; several entries are proposals to establish societies that may not exist yet (e.g. "Establishment of Kineni Farmers Cooperative Society") and are excluded.
registers.usable: Only as dated official mentions, not as a register.

registers.title: Community Groups Registration Act, 2022 (Cap. 108A)
registers.nyamiraEntries: n/a. The national Director of social development registers community groups (s.9, s.13) and keeps "the register" (s.20). The Act gives members a right to inspect their own group's register of members (s.29) but contains no provision opening the national register of groups to the public. No public list of self-help, women's or youth groups was found.
registers.usable: Explains why no public group register exists; a records request to the Nyamira county co-ordinator of social development (s.4) would be the route.
registers.confidence: high (text read from Kenya Law PDF copy)

notFound: Commissioner for Co-operative Development / State Department for Co-operatives: no public register of co-operative societies (by name, county or registration number) found; CMIS is referred to in news but no public search was found.
State Department for Social Protection (Directorate of Social Development): no public list of registered self-help, women's or youth groups or CBOs.
Kenya Dairy Board licensed operators by county: no official list found.
AFA Coffee Directorate list of coffee co-operatives/pulping stations by county: not found (news cites "21" registered coffee co-operatives in Nyamira; secondary, not used).
Uwezo Fund, NGAAF, Women Enterprise Fund, Youth Enterprise Development Fund: no published list of Nyamira groups funded; KNA stories give totals only.
County youth/women funds (e.g. the county-KCB "2Jiajiri" partnership reported May 2025): no beneficiary list published on nyamira.go.ke.
Tea and dairy co-operatives: tea is organised through KTDA-managed factory companies, not co-operatives; no dairy co-operative register found (CIDP/abstract give counts only).

Names using other Gusii-area words (e.g. SOUTH MUGIRANGO, which is in Kisii County, and NYAMIRAMBO, in Kigali) were deliberately excluded by the pattern.
